import copy, json
from work import evaluate

def check(name, req, ev, pol, expected):
    before=copy.deepcopy((req,ev,pol))
    got=evaluate(req,ev,pol)
    assert got == expected, (name, got, expected)
    assert (req,ev,pol)==before, name+' mutated inputs'

p={'required_conditions':['b','a'],'require_verified':False}
check('missing', {'claim':'c','conditions':{}}, [], p, {'status':'unknown','value':None,'sources':[],'unknowns':['a','b']})
check('none', {'claim':'c','conditions':{'a':1,'b':2}}, [], p, {'status':'unknown','value':None,'sources':[],'unknowns':['no matching evidence']})
check('false', {'claim':'c','conditions':{'a':1,'b':2}}, [{'source':'z','claim':'c','conditions':{'a':1,'b':2},'value':False}], p, {'status':'unsupported','value':False,'sources':['z'],'unknowns':[]})
check('conflict', {'claim':'c','conditions':{'a':1,'b':2}}, [{'source':'z','claim':'c','conditions':{'a':1,'b':2},'value':{'x':1}}, {'source':'a','claim':'c','conditions':{'a':1,'b':2},'value':{'x':2}}], p, {'status':'conflict','value':None,'sources':['a','z'],'unknowns':['source disagreement']})
check('canonical objects', {'claim':'c','conditions':{'a':1,'b':2}}, [{'source':'z','claim':'c','conditions':{'a':1,'b':2},'value':{'x':1,'y':2}}, {'source':'a','claim':'c','conditions':{'a':1,'b':2},'value':{'y':2,'x':1}}], p, {'status':'supported','value':{'x':1,'y':2},'sources':['a','z'],'unknowns':[]})
check('filters and supersedes', {'claim':'c','conditions':{'a':1,'b':2}}, [{'source':'old','claim':'c','conditions':{'a':1,'b':2},'value':3}, {'source':'new','claim':'c','conditions':{'a':1,'b':2},'value':3,'supersedes':['old']}, {'source':'wrong','claim':'d','conditions':{'a':1,'b':2},'value':9}, {'source':'withdrawn','claim':'c','conditions':{'a':1,'b':2},'value':9,'withdrawn':True}], p, {'status':'supported','value':3,'sources':['new'],'unknowns':[]})
check('verified', {'claim':'c','conditions':{'a':1,'b':2}}, [{'source':'u','claim':'c','conditions':{'a':1,'b':2},'value':3}, {'source':'v','claim':'c','conditions':{'a':1,'b':2},'value':3,'verified':True}], {'required_conditions':['a','b'],'require_verified':True}, {'status':'supported','value':3,'sources':['v'],'unknowns':[]})
print('all checks passed')
